# möbius for macOS 0.10.26

Providers, Extensions and Agent defaults now share the möbius sidebar group. Memory is grouped by project, with safer editing while saves are pending. Switching gateways clears gateway-owned settings drafts.

Updates the shared gateway contract alongside the iPhone Duo compatibility update. This release creates and runs möbius Bots only.

Requires gateway 0.16.44 and protocol 97. Existing gateway configuration and records must be converted manually before the cutover; this release does not add fallback support for older formats.
